excerpt.zh:
我们的裂隙探球被淹没在一种粘稠的红色液体中。在我们周围漂浮着巨大的圆盘状固体物质，但到目前为止，我们还没有与它们相撞。一层半凝胶状物质的固体墙四面包围着我们。我们轻松地滑行。

我们从裂隙中感受到的有节奏的脉冲与我们周围液体的谐波频率是同步的。每隔三秒钟，我们就会被一股压力向前推进，迫使我们更深地进入管状系统。我们的引擎很难抵抗液流。

这是一个收集样本的好机会，但这些的设备可能会阻碍我们在扭曲的隧道中航行。
excerpt.en: Our Rift Sphere has arrived submerged inside of a viscous, reddish fluid. All around us drift large disc-shaped blobs of more solid matter, but we have avoided collision with them thus far. A solid wall of a semi-gelatinous material surrounds us on all sides.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 1300–1330 全部事件，补上 1315.b/1316.b 的失败分支 1330（原为独立故事）。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 1300–1330; added the failure branch 1330 of 1315.b/1316.b (formerly a separate story).

note.zh: 花 100 奇异气体对付团块后，本阶段要么突破（1325，遗珍“血浆核心”），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败（1330，科学家与科研船被消化）。
note.en: After spending 100 exotic gases against the blob the stage either breaks through (1325, relic Plasmic Core) or fails on a roll, base 1.5% per roll (1330, scientist and science ship digested).

label.en: The Chamber: keeping the rig or not

note.zh: 两篇正文都叫“舱室”：1310 是切断拖网或未遇阻时的版本，1311 是用奇异气体救回拖网的版本（额外获得奇异气体或稀有晶体）。
note.en: Both are titled “The Chamber”: 1310 follows cutting the rig (or never getting stuck), 1311 follows saving the rig with exotic gases (extra exotic gases or rare crystals).

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1。它可能奖励遗珍，因此任一帝国正在探索时其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0；探索者未得到遗珍时解除锁定。
notes.en: Draw weight 1. Because it can award a relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it; the lock is lifted if the explorer did not obtain the relic.

texts.zh:
我们的裂隙探球被淹没在一种粘稠的红色液体中。在我们周围漂浮着巨大的圆盘状固体物质，但到目前为止，我们还没有与它们相撞。一层半凝胶状物质的固体墙四面包围着我们。我们轻松地滑行。

这是一个收集样本的好机会，但这些的设备可能会阻碍我们在扭曲的隧道中航行。
texts.en:
Our Rift Sphere has arrived submerged inside of a viscous, reddish fluid. All around us drift large disc-shaped blobs of more solid matter, but we have avoided collision with them thus far. A solid wall of a semi-gelatinous material surrounds us on all sides. We glide along easily.

The rhythmic pulsing we sensed from within this rift is in sync with the harmonic frequency of the liquid around us. Every three seconds, we are pushed forward with a rush of pressure driving us deeper into the tubular system. Resisting the flow is quite difficult on our engines.

This is a great opportunity for sample collection, but the appropriate apparatus may impede our navigation in these twisting tunnels.

notes.zh: 进入 1300 时脚本就设置了“取样拖网可用”标记，只有在 1305 选择切断拖网才会移除；因此选择“放心地继续前进”时，后文仍按保留拖网处理。
notes.en: Entering 1300 already sets the “sample rig available” flag; only cutting the rig in 1305 removes it, so after “Proceed forward at ease” later texts still treat the rig as kept.

texts.zh:
在进入裂隙后一段时间，我们突然停了下来，拖在我们身后的取样设备卡在了隧道系统的狭窄处。

我们试图用断断续续的推进力来挣脱，但是水流的力量使我们不能取得任何有意义的进展。

最安全的选择是切断取样设备，继续前进。然而，如果给我们的推进器注入一些异星天然气，我们还是有可能保存样本的。
texts.en:
Some time after arriving within the rift, we came to an abrupt halt as the sample apparatus trawling behind us became lodged in a narrowing of the tunnel system.

We attempted to free ourselves with intermittent bursts of propulsion, but the strength of the current prevented us from making any meaningful progress.

The safest option may be to simply cut the sample apparatus free and continue onward. However, it may still be possible to preserve the sample by supplementing our propulsion with a charge of exotic gases.

texts.zh:
在进入裂隙后一段时间，我们突然停了下来，拖在我们身后的取样设备卡在了隧道系统的狭窄处。

我们试图用断断续续的推进力来挣脱，但是水流的力量使我们不能取得任何有意义的进展。

我们别无选择只能切断取样设备以继续前进。
texts.en:
Some time after arriving within the rift, we came to an abrupt halt as the sample apparatus trawling behind us became lodged in a narrowing of the tunnel system.

We attempted to free ourselves with intermittent bursts of propulsion, but the strength of the current prevented us from making any meaningful progress.

We have no choice but to simply cut the sample apparatus free and continue onward.

label.zh: 把它切断。不值得冒这么大风险。
label.en: Cut it loose. The risk isn't worth it.

texts.zh:
向推进器注入异星天然气，我们终于将取样装置从管道壁上扯下来，由此我们可以取回这些宝贵的样品。

沿着隧道壁的层流使我们在航行过程中良好地保持在中心。几天过去了，没有发生什么大事。我们周围的盘状异物也被困在液流终；它们轻轻飘过球体，翻滚而过。

我们没有看到任何有知觉生命存在的证据。事实上，在这一点上，我们最强烈的假设是我们在一些未知的，巨大的超级有机体中。如果我们的存在被任何自然防御系统注意到，我们也还没有看到。

我们现在发现自己置身于一个巨大的房间。壁上排列着静脉状突起。腔壁有规律地膨胀和收缩，迫使数百万升的液体通过一个出口。

当我们尝试维持位置时，发现了第二个进入舱室的入口。微量的结晶物质悬浮在从隧道流出的液体中。水流的压力很低，只要用一些巧妙的导航，就可以探测到这个孔口。
texts.en:
By supplementing our propulsion with a charge of exotic gases, we were able to rip the apparatus free from the tunnel wall. We have since been able to recover the valuable samples.

The laminar flow along the tunnel walls has kept us well centered in our journey. Several days have passed without much incident. The disc-shaped foreign bodies surrounding us are also caught within the flow; they gently drift and tumble past the Sphere.

We have witnessed no evidence of sentient life. In fact, our strongest supposition at this point is that we are inside of some unknown, massive super organism. If our presence has been noticed by any natural defenses, we have not yet witnessed it.

We now find ourselves in an enormous chamber. The walls are lined with veiny protrusions. The chamber walls regularly expand and contract, forcing millions of liters of fluid through a single exit.

As we held our position, we discovered a second entryway into the chamber. Trace amounts of crystalline matter are suspended in the fluid coming from this tunnel. The pressure of its flow is low enough that with some skillful navigating this orifice could be explored.

texts.zh:
在洞口的另一边，我们进入了另一个腔体。这个舱室的规模使我们迄今为止见过的任何腔体都相形见绌。这里，细而精致的分枝卷须向各个方向伸展。它们都是如此错综复杂地交织在一起，我们很难再前进一步。这种环境中的流体充满了气体，这对我们来说很容易收集。

突然，几百米外出现了一个星舰大小的无定形团块。我们试图从远处观察它却引起了它的注意。

实体通过膜把裂隙探球迅速吸收。它的内部主要由一种腐蚀性酶组成；我们说话这会儿，球体的船体正在被消化。

也许需要紧急撤离，但我们也推测可以通过适当的气体和液体组合来中和其中的酶。
texts.en:
On the far side of the orifice, we entered another cavity. This chamber dwarfed any other we had seen thus far. Here, thin and delicately branching tendrils stretch out in every direction. They are all so intricately woven together that it has become difficult to proceed. The fluid in this environment is saturated with gases which have been easy for us to collect.

Suddenly, an amorphous blob the size of a starship was observed several hundred meters away. Attempting to observe it from a distance, we somehow managed to draw its attention.

The Rift Sphere was quickly absorbed through the entity's membrane. Its interior is composed mostly of a corrosive enzyme; the Sphere's hull is being digested as we speak.

Evacuation may be appropriate, but we theorize its enzymes can be neutralized with the right combination of gases and fluid we have at our disposal.

label.zh: 泵入异星天然气，干掉这头野兽。
label.en: Pump exotic gases. Neutralize the beast.

texts.zh:
尽管这个生物酸性的酶对船体很危险，但我们有很长的时间来启动紧急锚，逃回到裂隙的另一端去。

不过，我们的航行也并非全是徒劳。我们的取样网中回收了大量来自那头野兽的物质。我们的生物学家希望能调查其中包含的秘密。
texts.en:
Though the creature's acidic enzymes were a danger to the hull, we had plenty of time to engage the emergency anchor and escape back through the other side of the rift.

Our voyage was not all in vain, however. A significant amount of material from the beast was recovered by our sampling rig. Our biologists are eager to investigate what secrets it may contain.

texts.zh:
尽管这个生物酸性的酶对船体很危险，但我们有很长的时间来启动紧急锚，逃回到裂隙的另一端去。

不过，我们的航行也并非全是徒劳。在我们的船体上发现了大量来自那头野兽的物质。我们的生物学家希望能调查其中包含的秘密。
texts.en:
Though the creature's acidic enzymes were a danger to the hull, we had plenty of time to engage the emergency anchor and escape back through the other side of the rift.

Our voyage was not all in vain, however. A significant amount of material from the beast was found still attached to our hull. Our biologists are eager to investigate what secrets it may contain.

label.zh: 把酸性中和掉，然后给我们来一杯。
label.en: Neutralize the acid. Then we shall drink.

note.zh: 起锚撤离；获得大量星界丝缕与“裂隙流体样本”修正（保留取样拖网时 10 年，否则 5 年）。探索结束。
note.en: Pull anchor and escape; a large astral thread reward and the Rift Fluid Samples modifier (10 years if the rig was kept, otherwise 5). The exploration ends.

texts.zh:
尽管其尺寸巨大，但这头生物的生物学却极度原始。

在释放出我们独特的混合气体后不久，它的膜就溶解了。它的细胞完整性被破坏，内容物逸散到周围的液流中，直到只剩下巨大的核心。

我们很高兴地报告对这个物体的成功回收，它与我们维度中许多单细胞生物的细胞核并没有完全不同。

此外，此前救回来的取样网中可以取回大量来自那头野兽的物质。我们的生物学家迫不及待地想研究其中隐藏的秘密了。

我们猜测这个生物是这个巨大的管道和液体网络中的某种抗体，它将我们视为外来威胁。我们带着战利品伤痕累累地回来了。
texts.en:
While significant in size, the creature turned out to be remarkably primitive in its biology.

Very soon after releasing our unique concoction of gases, its membrane dissolved. No longer able to maintain cellular integrity, its internals were carried away into the surrounding currents until only the massive core remained.

We are pleased to report that we have successfully recovered the object, which is not wholly unlike the nucleus of many single-celled organisms from our own dimension.

In addition, the sampling rig we managed to save previously has been able to recover a significant amount of material from the beast. Our biologists are eager to investigate what secrets it may contain.

Our speculation is that this creature was some sort of antibody in this colossal network of tubes and fluid, and identified us as a foreign threat. Damaged by the encounter, we have returned with our trophy.

note.zh: 气体混合物溶解了团块的膜，只剩核心；获得遗珍“血浆核心”与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: The gas mixture dissolves the blob's membrane, leaving its core; the relic Plasmic Core and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
我们与[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]的联络中断了。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了裂隙探球的残余部分。

它几乎被完全溶解，大量高浓度生物质包裹着每一寸残骸。我们确信这可以带来新的科技突破。
texts.en:
We have lost contact with our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural].

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered what was left of the Rift Sphere.

While it is mostly dissolved, there is a highly concentrated biomass coating all remaining pieces. We are certain this will lead to new breakthroughs.

texts.zh:
我们与科研团队的联络中断了。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了裂隙探球的残余部分。

它几乎被完全溶解，大量高浓度生物质包裹着每一寸残骸。我们的生物学家确信这可以带来新的科技突破。

我们赞扬全体船员的勇敢。他们的名字将被铭记。
texts.en:
We have lost contact with the Science team.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered what was left of the Rift Sphere.

While it is mostly dissolved, there is a highly concentrated biomass coating all remaining pieces. Our biologists are certain this will lead to new breakthroughs.

We commend the crew for its bravery. Their names will be remembered.

note.zh: 失败分支：科学家死亡、科研船被摧毁；从残骸上的生物质获得 10 年“裂隙流体样本”与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Failure branch: the scientist dies and the science ship is destroyed; the biomass on the wreck gives 10 years of Rift Fluid Samples and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

texts.zh:
一路与流体抗争，我们终于挤进了上一个房间的一个分支。我们进入了一个由颤抖的水晶组成的洞穴，周围的墙壁过滤了来自各个方向的液体，留下了结晶残留物。

突然，几百米外出现了一个星舰大小的无定形团块。我们试图从远处观察它却引起了它的注意。

实体通过膜把裂隙探球迅速吸收。它的内部主要由一种腐蚀性酶组成；我们说话这会儿，球体的船体正在被消化。

也许需要紧急撤离，但我们也推测可以通过适当的气体和液体组合来中和其中的酶。
texts.en:
Fighting through the current, we were able to squeeze into an off-shoot from the previous chamber. We emerged into a cavern of quivering crystals. The walls around us filtered fluid from every direction, causing a crystalline residue to be left behind.

Suddenly, an amorphous blob the size of a starship was observed several hundred meters away. Attempting to observe it from a distance, we somehow managed to draw its attention.

The Rift Sphere was quickly absorbed through the entity's membrane. Its interior is composed mostly of a corrosive enzyme; the Sphere's hull is being digested as we speak.

Evacuation may be appropriate, but we theorize its enzymes can be neutralized with the right combination of gases and fluid we have at our disposal.

summary.text:
# 流体 / The Fluid

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`common/astral_rifts/00_astral_rifts.txt:154`；`events/astral_rifts_1_events.txt:875–1431`（1300–1330）
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（全篇 whole story；原独立的失败事件 1330 已并入 / former standalone failure event 1330 merged in）

## 如何开始 How it starts

裂隙类型从探索帝国的裂隙池中按权重抽取：权重 1。它能产出遗珍“血浆核心”，所以任一帝国正在探索它时，其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0（`00_astral_rifts.txt:154–168`）。每阶段结束掷 1–10 的骰子，加技能与线索、减难度，≥14 进入下一章；第一章 1300 难度为 0。

Drawn by weight from the explorer's rift pool: weight 1. Because it can award the Plasmic Core relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it (`00_astral_rifts.txt:154–168`). Each phase ends with a d10 plus skill and clues minus difficulty; 14+ opens the next chapter. Chapter 1300 has difficulty 0.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 流体（1300）：探球浸没在有节律搏动的红色黏液中，被推进一套管道系统。部署取样拖网（→ 1305 受阻，难度 5）或放心前进（→ 1310）。
2. 受阻（1305）：拖网卡住。切断（→ 1310）或有奇异气体时花 50 用推进器挣脱（→ 1311，额外生物学研究选项）。
3. 舱室（1310/1311）：一个规律收缩的巨大腔室——推测是某个超级有机体的体内。随液流出去（→ 1315，难度 2）或探索结晶孔（→ 1316，难度 5）；1311 中两选项还分别给 200 奇异气体或 200 稀有晶体。
4. 团块（1315/1316）：一个星舰大小的团块把探球吞入，腐蚀性的酶开始消化船体。立刻起锚返航（→ 1320）或泵入 100 奇异气体中和它（→ 1325 / 失败 1330）。

1. The Fluid (1300): the Sphere is submerged in a rhythmically pulsing red fluid and pushed through a network of tubes. Deploy the sample rig (→ 1305 Snagged, difficulty 5) or proceed at ease (→ 1310).
2. Snagged (1305): the rig is stuck. Cut it loose (→ 1310) or, with exotic gases, spend 50 to burn free (→ 1311, plus a biology research option).
3. The Chamber (1310/1311): a vast rhythmically contracting cavity — perhaps inside some immense organism. Follow the flow (→ 1315, difficulty 2) or explore the crystalline orifice (→ 1316, difficulty 5); in 1311 the two options also give 200 exotic gases or 200 rare crystals.
4. The Blob (1315/1316): a starship-sized blob engulfs the Sphere and its acidic enzymes start digesting the hull. Pull anchor (→ 1320) or pump 100 exotic gases to neutralise it (→ 1325 / failure 1330).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1320 提取：逃回裂隙外，带回生物物质；大量星界丝缕与“裂隙流体样本”（保留拖网 10 年，否则 5 年）。“演化猎手”起源另有专属选项（局势进度与 DNA）。
- 1325 溶解：团块溶解只剩核心；遗珍“血浆核心”与大量星界丝缕。
- 1330 被溶解（失败分支，基础 1.5%/次掷骰）：科学家死亡、科研船被摧毁；残骸上的生物质带来 10 年“裂隙流体样本”与大量星界丝缕。

- 1320 Extraction: escape with biological material; a large astral thread reward and Rift Fluid Samples (10 years if the rig was kept, otherwise 5). Evolutionary Predators empires get an exclusive option (situation progress and DNA).
- 1325 Dissolution: the blob dissolves to its core; the Plasmic Core relic and a large astral thread reward.
- 1330 Dissolved (failure branch, base 1.5% per roll): the scientist dies and the science ship is destroyed; the biomass on the wreck yields 10 years of Rift Fluid Samples and a large astral thread reward.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 是否拥有奇异气体（科技或库存）决定 1305、1315、1316 的正文版本以及“使用紧急燃气”“泵入异星天然气”两个选项是否出现；1315/1316 另有格式塔版本。
- 拖网标记：进入 1300 时即设置，只有 1305 切断时移除；因此选择“放心地继续前进”时后文仍按保留拖网处理（1320 给 10 年修正）。

- Having exotic gases (technology or stock) selects the texts of 1305, 1315 and 1316 and shows the “Use emergency gases” / “Pump exotic gases” options; 1315/1316 also have gestalt texts.
- Rig flag: set on entering 1300 and removed only by cutting the rig in 1305, so after “Proceed forward at ease” later texts still treat the rig as kept (1320 gives the 10-year modifier).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：裂隙定义与遗珍锁定；1300–1330 全部事件；1315.b/1316.b 的 `on_roll_failed = astral_rift.1330`（`astral_rifts_1_events.txt:1157–1161, 1270–1274`）；1330 的 `kill_leader` 与 `destroy_fleet`。
- 修正：编译图漏掉失败分支，1330 曾是独立故事；已用两条桥接并入，标注 1325/1330 互斥，并说明两篇“舱室”的差别。

- Checked: rift definition and relic lock; every event 1300–1330; `on_roll_failed = astral_rift.1330` of 1315.b/1316.b (`astral_rifts_1_events.txt:1157–1161, 1270–1274`); `kill_leader` and `destroy_fleet` in 1330.
- Correction: the compiled graph missed the failure branch and 1330 had been a separate story; merged with two bridges, 1325/1330 marked exclusive, and the two “Chamber” versions explained.
